description: This file defines a React functional component named RoleRequired that acts as a role-based access control wrapper for UI components. It uses custom hook useAuthorization to determine if the user's roles are loading or if they have access, rendering different UI accordingly.

methods.name: RoleRequired({ allowedRoles, children })
methods.description: React functional component that renders children if the user has one of the allowed roles, shows a loading UI if roles are loading, or an UnauthorizedPage if access is denied.
